The '''Bakur Ring''' was the outermost of the three concentric districts of [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. The district was used primarily for service and industrial work, and was also known as the "'''Red Ring'''" due to the [[Color/Legends|color]] of its streetlights. The [[Salis D'aar Penitentiary]] was located within the district.<ref name="GatORW" />
